name: reportsForLoo-unknown-id
description: Report history for an unknown id.
query:
query looReportHistory($id: ID!) {
  reportsForLoo(id: $id) {
    ...LooReportFragment
  }
}
fragment LooReportFragment on Report {
  id
  createdAt
  verifiedAt
  active
  location {
    lat
    lng
  }
  name
  openingTimes
  accessible
  men
  women
  allGender
  babyChange
  children
  urinalOnly
  radar
  automatic
  noPayment
  paymentDetails
  notes
  removalReason
  attended
  geohash
  isSystemReport
  contributor
}
